record.paper_title: Conferences WORDS, years 1997-2017: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: How many k-abelian equivalence classes of words of a given length contain an nth power?

evidence.quote: How many k-abelian equivalence classes of words of a given length contain an nth power?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an alphabet $\Sigma$ and an integer $k\ge 1$. Two finite words $u,v\in\Sigma^*$ are said to be $k$-abelian equivalent, written $u\sim_k v$, if $|u|=|v|$ and for every word $w\in\Sigma^*$ with $|w|\le k$, the number of occurrences of $w$ as a factor of $u$ equals the number of occurrences of $w$ as a factor of $v$. This is an equivalence relation on $\Sigma^*$ that refines abelian equivalence (the case $k=1$).

For an integer $n\ge 2$, an $n$th power is a word of the form $w^n=ww\cdots w$ ($n$ concatenated copies of some $w\in\Sigma^*$).

Determine, as a function of the alphabet size $|\Sigma|$, the integers $k\ge 1$, $n\ge 2$, and the length $\ell\ge 1$, the number of $k$-abelian equivalence classes of words of length $\ell$ over $\Sigma$ that contain at least one $n$th power.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches return work on cardinalities of k-abelian equivalence classes, regularity of class sizes, and avoidability of k-abelian powers, but no source giving a closed-form count of k-abelian classes (of words of fixed length) that contain an nth power. Status appears unresolved in the surveyed literature; classified as unknown.

status_evidence.title: On cardinalities of k-abelian equivalence classes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cardinalities of k-abelian equivalence classes; does not address counting classes containing nth powers.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related counting questions are studied but not the specific question of how many classes contain an nth power.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of k-Abelian Equivalence Classes of Fixed Cardinality
status_evidence.snippet: Regularity results for the set of words whose k-abelian class has fixed cardinality.
status_evidence.claim: Related structural results exist, but the counting of classes containing nth powers is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Strongly k-Abelian Repetitions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies k-abelian repetitions and their avoidability.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on k-abelian powers does not yield the requested enumeration.
